name: Monthly Encounters: Jan
source:
You're a small time drug dealer and one of your customers knocks on your door. She needs a fix but she's out of money. It's not pretty what the drugs are doing to her so what will you do - turn her away, take advantage or help her?

[From [url=https://iskonsko-studio.itch.io/monthly-encounters-jan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名小毒贩，一位女顾客敲响了你的门。她毒瘾发作，却没钱了。毒品已经让她不堪重负，你会怎么做——把她拒之门外，趁机占她便宜，还是帮她一把？

[摘自[url=https://iskonsko-studio.itch.io/monthly-encounters-jan]itch.io[/url]]
